newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Air Mauritius pushes bourse index down.
newsitem.headline: Air Mauritius pushes bourse index down.

text.p: National airline company Air Mauritius continued to depress bourse index Semdex which ended down by 1.05 points to 360.93 on Wednesday, stock brokers said.
Total volume was posted at 9.56 million rupees on 260,254 shares from 11,14 million rupees on 289,104 shares on Monday.

Market sources said Air Mauritius fell by the maximum permitted six percent for four consecutive trading sessions on account of its worse financial results forecasted for the year ending 31 March 1997.

"The focus of the (stock) market is without any doubt on Air Mauritius. With that type of financial results, no one really knows until when its share price will continue to slump. Your guess is as good as mine," one broker said.

Air Mauritius lost 2.20 rupees to 33.80 on 11,950 shares. The national carrier has forecast an operating profit of 60 million rupees for the year ended 31 March 1997, down from 610 million rupees the previous year.
Many shares were on the downside as investors retreated on the sidelines waiting for fresh news on the market.
"It's difficult to say that there is widespread buying interest on the market especially when it (Air Mauritius) is driving the Semdex down," a broker added.
Mauritius Commercial Bank gained 50 cents to 85 rupees on 62,638 shares and accounted for more than 50 percent of the day's trading. State Bank of Mauritius remained at 11.20 rupees on 56,855 shares.
Rogers was unchanged at 100 rupees on 3,171 shares but Ireland Blyth rose 10 cents to 14.40 rupees on 14,585 shares.

In the hotel sector, Grand Baie Hotel was stable to 45.60 rupees on 18,838 shares and Sun Resorts was unchanged to 44 rupees on 6,300 shares. New Mauritius Hotels gained 20 cents to 35.20 rupees on 2,071 shares.

Investment stocks Fincorp fell by 3 rupees to 72 rupees on 1,900 shares, United Docks lost 60 cents to 39.90 rupees on 5,974 shares and National Investment Trust gained 20 cents to 11 rupees on 1,844 shares.
